mainEntity.name: How much does a design consultation cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a design consultation varies depending on the project's complexity and scope. Some initial consultations may be complimentary for a basic overview, while more in-depth sessions requiring site visits and preliminary conceptual work will have a fee. We provide transparent pricing upfront, discussing any potential charges before scheduling. Our aim is to ensure you receive valuable insights that help you make informed decisions about your investment, whether it's a renovation in Bungalow Heaven or a new build.
acceptedAnswer.description: The cost of a design consultation varies by project complexity. Some initial consultations are complimentary, while in-depth sessions may have a fee, which we will discuss upfront.
